title: Saved engineering interfaces release their views on reload
summary: Actual common host cleanup on two saved model-created interfaces; no process restart or review response.

manualSteps.label: Open interface
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved Heat comparison or Focus-wheel working-interface link.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the page three times. Check that the same saved interface and exact results return.

manualSteps.label: Leave workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Navigate away. Return to the saved interface and check its results. Leave all review decisions unchanged.

steps.label: heat saved interface opens
steps.summary: The current saved interface displays its exact engineering results.
steps.expected: Exact saved revision, current results and active presentation.
steps.actual: 18 exact results; existing source/build and run files unchanged.

steps.label: heat reload 1 releases previous view
steps.summary: Reload restores the same saved interface and closes its prior presentation.
steps.purpose: Verify actual browser departure cleanup rather than only component unmount.
steps.expected: Prior exact view closed; fresh working presentation with the same results.
steps.actual: Previous exact presentation is closed; 18 result identities and immutable records unchanged.

steps.label: heat ready to leave workspace
steps.summary: The final saved view is intact before leaving.
steps.purpose: Retain the last visible screen before document departure.
steps.action: Inspect the saved view before navigating away.
steps.expected: Same exact results and review state.
steps.actual: Saved view and current results present; no review action requested.

steps.label: heat departure releases view
steps.summary: Navigating away closes the exact presentation and preserves the process.
steps.purpose: Check native view cleanup independently in the backend.
steps.expected: Exact presentation closed; process and saved artifacts unchanged.
steps.actual: Exact presentation closed; all baseline files and UI authoring records unchanged.
